sdc.daemon.CallMetrics.title: CallMetrics
sdc.daemon.CallMetrics.description: The model calls of a step or of a run, as its events book them: one event `runbook.model-call` per call the relay booked (a run on a route), and the calls of an event `runbook.cost-booked` (a step of a run on no route, booked from its programs' cost records). A number the events do not hold is absent, never 0.

input_tokens.description: The input tokens of the calls whose answer reported them; absent when calls were booked and none reported any (unknown). 0 with no call.

calls_without_tokens.description: The calls that did not report both their input and output tokens: a call whose answer had no usage, and every call of `runbook.cost-booked`, whose event holds no tokens.

cost_micro_usd.description: What the calls of known cost booked (`cost_known` true: the route's declared prices times the tokens). A call of unknown cost adds nothing here.

unknown_cost_calls.description: The calls whose cost is not known: a relay call booked at its reservation (`cost_known` false), and every call of `runbook.cost-booked`, whose event does not say whether its cost was known.

booked_micro_usd.description: What the calls booked in the spend ledger, reservations of calls of unknown cost included.
